name_reason: Convention-compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>; accurately reflects body (paints a threat/AoE-coverage overlay for the units of a selected team). No Ghidra address residue. _for_team has no numeric ID suffix to scrutinize.
purpose: During battle action target selection, paint a threat/AoE-coverage overlay by stamping an AoE '+' pattern at every alive unit of the team chosen by the asymmetric team-selector.
logic_summary: Iterate party slots i=0..data_fd2_battle_party_member_count-1 over the runtime_char array (stride 0x50). For each slot: skip if dead (flags bit0 set). Then apply the asymmetric team filter: when team_selector==0 stamp units whose team!=0 (ally/npc+player side); when team_selector!=0 stamp units whose team==0 (enemy side). For matching units call fd2_mark_aoe_plus_pattern_at(pos_x, pos_y), which marks the threat-overlay layer of the tile map.

params.name: ctx
params.semantics: Asymmetric team selector controlling which side's units are stamped: 0 -> stamp team!=0 (ally overlay); nonzero -> stamp team==0 (enemy overlay). AI callers (fd2_ai_walk_to_target_tile etc.) forward their own per-operation ctx; fd2_player_action_menu_loop passes literal 1.
params.reason: Current name 'ctx' is generic; the value's actual role is to select which team's units get the overlay (with the documented asymmetric/inverted convention). 'team_selector' matches the Ghidra plate's documented param name and the established convention shared with the AI targeting routines, removing the vague 'ctx'.

returns.semantics: No return value; side effect is mutation of the threat-overlay layer of the battle tile map via fd2_mark_aoe_plus_pattern_at.
